name: Custard or Cream Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sweet milk
ingredients.originalText: half a cup of sweet milk

ingredients.name: heaping teaspoonful of cream of tartar
ingredients.originalText: one heaping teaspoonful of cream of tartar

ingredients.name: two tablespoonfuls of cornstarch or flour
ingredients.originalText: two tablespoonfuls of cornstarch or flour
ingredients.quantityText: two tablespoonfuls of cornstarch or flour

instructions.text: Add half a cup of sweet milk in which is dissolved half a teaspoonful of soda
Beat the whites of six eggs to a stiff froth and add to the mixture
Stir cream of tartar thoroughly into sifted flour and add quickly
Bake in a moderate oven in layers like jelly cake
For the Custard: Put two cups of sweet milk into a clean suitable dish and set it in a dish of boiling water on the range or stove
When the milk comes to a boil add cornstarch or flour stirred into half a cup of sugar, adding the yolks of four eggs and a little cold milk
Stir this into the boiling milk and when cooked thick enough set aside to cool
Add the flavoring, either vanilla or lemon
Spread custard between the cake layers

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream together sugar and butter
2. Add half a cup of sweet milk in which is dissolved half a teaspoonful of soda
3. Beat the whites of six eggs to a stiff froth and add to the mixture
4. Stir cream of tartar thoroughly into sifted flour and add quickly
5. Bake in a moderate oven in layers like jelly cake
6. For the Custard: Put two cups of sweet milk into a clean suitable dish and set it in a dish of boiling water on the range or stove
7. When the milk comes to a boil add cornstarch or flour stirred into half a cup of sugar, adding the yolks of four eggs and a little cold milk
8. Stir this into the boiling milk and when cooked thick enough set aside to cool
9. Add the flavoring, either vanilla or lemon
10. Spread custard between the cake layers
